bootstrap.method: paired class-stratified image percentile bootstrap and paired hierarchical checkpoint/image bootstrap
bootstrap.resampling_unit: official test source image; same multiplicity for both methods and every fixed checkpoint/noise pair
bootstrap.aggregation: Macro-F1 per run, mean noise within checkpoint, then mean checkpoints
bootstrap.interval: marginal 95% percentile; three conditions, no multiplicity correction
bootstrap.checkpoint_resampling: Resample three training-seed clusters with replacement; preserve the three noise runs within each chosen checkpoint; same image multiplicities across all clusters and both methods
bootstrap.limitations: Only three training clusters, three fixed noises; image independence assumed, no verified official test tracks; not a population CI for real cameras
